rate.notes: 'מניות ואגרות חוב 0.55% (20 ש"ח מינימום 20,000 מקסימום)'. Footnote 4: the mutual-fund exclusion does not cover a tracking fund or a fund whose units are listed on TASE, so Israeli ETFs and listed fund units pay this line. Notes: (1) a split order pays one minimum per day; (2) an order not executed for a reason depending on the client pays the minimum only if a clerk acted; (3) also charged on unlisted securities; (4) gives the internet price, recorded as the direct line. The tariff states the bank may charge less than the printed amounts except for supervised services. The part's effective date is printed '06/02/20217', a misprint in the source; effective_from is left null rather than guessed. Tracking funds (2026-10-31): the exclusion of mutual funds on this line does not cover a tracking fund, so a tracking fund pays this line; a traditional fund that is not listed does not.
